25th october 2026 30th sunday of the year for the church that we may faithfully proclaim the gospel and bear witness to god’s love in our care for the poor, the vulnerable and the forgotten. let us pray to the lord for the poor, the homeless and all those who struggle to provide the b asic necessities of life. may we be inspired by christ’s teaching to share what we have, to offer our ‘cloak’ to those who have none, and to treat everyone with compassion, generosity and dign ity. let us pray to the lord we pray for peace in the world. may hatred and distrust give way to unders tanding, that nations may work together to build a world where peace and justice prevail. let us pray to the lord we pray for the sick and elderly and those whose mobility or circumstances are limiting. may the lord grant them healing, strength and patience. may their caregivers too be strengthened in their loving service to those who suffer. let us pray to the lord we pray for all those who are struggling with the demands and pressures o f daily life, those who feel overwhelmed by worry, responsibility or uncertainty. may lord be their ‘strength’, their ‘rock’ and their ‘stronghold’ . let us pray to the lord for those who have died:
